raw_blocks: Make More Confident Workforce Decisions
Move beyond one-time checks with background screening, identity verification, and continuous monitoring across the workforce lifecycle.
Reduce Hiring Delays and Help Protect Your Workforce
From background checks to continuous monitoring, we’ve got you covered.
Drug & Occupational Health Screening
Instant Oral Fluid Drug Screening
Affordable Care Act & Compliance
ONBOARD WITH EASE & EFFICIENCY
A Connected Platform for Workforce Decisions

Our platform unifies background screening, identity verification, and monitoring into a single experience. AI enabled automation, integrated workflows, and real-time data help reduce manual effort while improving speed, consistency, and visibility, globally.
Request a Demo Explore Solutions
Connected Solutions Across the Workforce Lifecycle
Address hiring delays, onboarding friction, and workforce risk with solutions designed to support better workforce outcomes.
Global background checks that help you hire faster, help mitigate risk, and build workforce trust.

Conduct thorough business due diligence investigations before any investment, merger, or acquisition to evaluate financial health, legal standing, and operational risks. Gain critical insights into an entity’s structure, reputation, and strategic fit so you can make better informed investment decisions.
With online access to 90% of U.S. criminal records, our background checks deliver fast, consistent results and a clear view of a candidate’s history for informed hiring.

Maintaining a safe and productive work environment is critical. We offer a robust suite of pre- and post-hire drug & occupational health screening services to help you meet your compliance and work policy requirements.

First Advantage offers Tax Credit solutions – such as Work Opportunity Tax Credits (WOTC) – that help employers identify, capture and maximize available federal and state tax savings while reducing administrative burden associated with tax credit programs.

Protect your business by conducting a more thorough screening of CEOs, board members, and key leaders. Our executive investigations uncover litigation, criminal records, conflicts of interest, and potential hidden risks — helping you make confident, informed hiring decisions.

First Advantage’s fingerprinting services can help streamline your mandated fingerprinting requirements for hiring, licensing, or other regulated activities that require fingerprint-based criminal history. Simplify the process with fast, live scan technology, a convenient nationwide biometrics collection network, and a partner with proven expertise.
Our robust, multi-layered identity verifications help you mitigate potential fraud, reduce friction, and improve screening accuracy early and often across the hiring lifecycle.

Hire faster and eliminate delays associated with lab scheduling and responses. Our modern, convenient, and cost-effective drug screening tests can be administered virtually anywhere, with results in minutes.

Gain enhanced candidate insights that help you hire smarter. Our social media searches leverage intelligent automation and expert human analysis to provide you with valuable insights that traditional background checks may miss, helping you strengthen trust throughout your entire organization.
Centralize your entire driver safety program using a trusted partner with a proven industry track record of helping companies hire quickly and keeping their drivers compliant.

Quickly and cost-effectively confirm your candidate’s experience, skills, and credentials with verifications that use smart automations combined with our proprietary Verified!® database of 130M+ records.
Our guided, end-to-end Form I-9/E-Verify solution simplifies complex U.S. employment eligibility with ease and efficiency.
Our Form 1095 and 1094 delivery tools, customizable monitoring dashboard, and audit-ready reporting help you support your compliance requirements throughout the ACA lifecycle.

Our monitoring solutions — criminal records, driver records, healthcare, and global sanctions — allow for continuous monitoring of high-risk employees and drivers, providing proactive risk management and helping to ensure regulatory compliance through our robust data coverage across global systems.
Why Our Partners and Customers Trust First Advantage*
Customers: 66% Fortune 100 50%+ Fortune 500
U.S. criminal screens close in one day
ATS and HCM integrated partners

Our advanced fulfillment systems will accelerate the turnaround times on your background criminal record checks. Approximately 90% of our U.S. criminal searches utilize intelligent automation to speed up the entire employment criminal background check process of searching for court records*.

raw_blocks: Trust in a Changing World™
At First Advantage, it’s our mission to deliver innovative solutions and insights to help our customers manage risk and hire the best talent.
Insights to Hire with Confidence

Every day, we’re on a journey to help you hire smarter and onboard faster, making your HR processes more manageable and effective. Our global employment background checks, identity, and verification solutions help you manage risk and equip you with the insights to hire with confidence. We’re meeting at the convergence of people and technology — with solutions that enable you to protect your brand and help create a safer environment for all your stakeholders.
Founded in 2003, We Aim to Deliver…
Why Our Partners and Customers Trust First Advantage*
Customers: 66% Fortune 100 50%+ Fortune 500
U.S. criminal screens close in one day
ATS and HCM integrated partners
Embracing the Future with AI

We take a responsible and ethical approach to AI technology, acknowledging its influence and capacity to shape society. In designing and deploying many of our products, we harness AI to enrich user experiences and streamline operations. Consequently, we prioritize privacy, fairness, accountability, and transparency.
In a tech-driven world, we never lose sight of what matters most – people. We build trust by showing transparency, respect, and a people-first mindset during every interaction.
We challenge ourselves to think bigger, learn constantly, and find better ways to serve our customers and each other.

We hold ourselves accountable to the highest ethical standards, making decisions rooted in honesty and respect, while also embracing responsible AI practices that prioritize fairness and transparency.
We collaborate openly, value every voice, hold each other accountable, and grow stronger by solving challenges side by side.

Our technology and insights are focused on solving real problems. We listen and build connections with our customers to understand their needs, earn their trust, and deliver on what matters most to them.
Celebrating What Makes Us Different

Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the array of voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

First Advantage is an organization driven by progress and service. We love that the work we do matters. As an industry pioneer with a deep sense of responsibility to our customers, employees, and stakeholders, our collective purpose drives individual effort.

First Advantage has six Employee Impact Groups (EIGs) that embrace unity through inclusion. Our African, Black, and Caribbean (AB&C), Gen-fluencers, People Who Care For People, Pride, ¡Viva!, and Women @ FA EIGs are open to all employees and directly support our efforts to create a positive employee experience for our global workforce.

This award-winning leadership development program is designed for First Advantage managers, providing tools for building teams and becoming better leaders. It empowers front-line managers and many subject-matter experts promoted from within.

We believe in giving back to the places where we live and do business. Our FA Cares initiative allows team members to use their skills and time to support important causes, projects, and not-for-profit organizations worldwide. Examples of volunteer opportunities our employees and customers have been a part of include assembling bikes and donating them to Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta, writing Valentine’s Day cards for St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital patients, working with Sleep in Heavenly Peace to build beds for children, and making Build-A-Bears during Collaborate, our annual customer conference, before giving them to organizations across Florida.
Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
Chief People & Culture Officer
Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer
Chief Product and Technology Officer
General Manager EMEA and APAC
Chief Executive Officer and Director
